title: Proximity Death
description: Adds a sound when someone dies, as well as a distance based death message and sound
body:
This mod adds a distance based death message and sound, meaning that at a certain distance from a player dying you will not hear the sound or see the death message on chat.

Features
- Adds a sound to when someone dies
- At a certain distance, the sound will not be audible and the death message will not show up
- Customizable distance for the sound and death message.
- Compatibility with Geyser servers (cross-platform)


This mod is an unoficial "port" of the mod "Proximity Deathmessage" for neoforge 1.21.1 . as it has source code from this but has substancial changes to ensure it works on the latest version.

https://modrinth.com/mod/proximity-deathmessage

This is a port for that mod on fabric 26.1.2 and up


Fabric API required!
